english: Thank you all for gathering!
What is this gathering...
Dunno...
Everyone gathered here shares the same wound -\nwe're comrades, so to speak!
What? What is this about!?
Don't you see?\nWhat everyone here has in common... is...
'Small boobs'! That's what!
Wh...
Ugh...
Wh-what did you say...
We've all felt lonely, frustrated, and hurt\nover our 'disappointing chests'!
D-disappointing... I-I'm not, really...
Let we of the disappointing small-boobs band together,\nform an alliance, and rise to become a giant political party!
Small boobs aren't disappointing!\nThere are people into that!
When clothes shopping, kids' sizes fit -\nwhat a bargain!!
And people with big boobs seem dumb~.
We, on the other hand, don't waste blood on pointless places,\nso we think fast and sharp~!
H-huh? What's wrong, everyone...?
Say one more word and I'll blow a hole through you!
Got it, you wanna die...\nokay, let's kill her!
Wh-wh-why do I have to hear that from YOU!!
Huh...?
Explosion!\nBlow a hole! Blow a hole! Blow a hole!!\nBrace yourself!!
Huh? Wh-why!?\nWaaah
And so, the Anti-Big-Boobs Alliance was formed...\nnot.
Uuuh... everyone... be honest with yourselves~.
